Pilot Plant Design Engineer: Carbon Removal
Principal Pilot Plant Design Engineer: Carbon Removal
Process Engineering - Data Center Cooling
postings.text:
The Role
We are seeking an experienced mechanical or process engineer to contribute to the design and development of innovative products for the data center industry. Based out of our laboratory and engineering site just outside Princeton, NJ, this role focuses on identifying efficient integration opportunities for process and chemical technologies within data centers. The ideal candidate will combine strong process engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience in the data center industry.
Responsibilities
- Design innovative cooling and heat transfer systems that efficiently integrate with data center operations
- Optimize air handling and thermal management for both cooling and carbon capture
- Develop specifications for critical equipment including:
- Advanced heat exchange systems
- High-efficiency air handling units
- Instrumentation and controls
- System integration components
- Design system layout and integration strategy
- Support pilot deployment in operating data centers
- Develop operational protocols that ensure reliable data center performance
- Play a central role in identifying opportunities for new technologies within data centers
Skills and Experiences
- Background in chemical, mechanical or process engineering
- 5+ years experience in process engineering, chemical engineering, or technology demonstrations
- 3+ years experience in data center infrastructure, cooling systems, or related field
- A strong understanding of:
- Data center design and engineering
- Data center cooling options
- Air handling and distribution
- Heat exchange systems
- Environmental controls
- System integration in the data center environment
- Strong communication and collaboration skills
- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced startup environment
- Preferred qualifications include:
- Prior experience developing a first-of-a-kind technology
- Proficiency with process simulation software (e.g. gPROMS, Aspen) and/or engineering design software (e.g. AutoCAD)
What we offer
- Competitive salary commensurate with experience
- Health, dental, and vision insurance
- Flexible and generous paid time off
- 401(k) Plan with a company match to invest in your future
- Annual all-company offsites
- Generous employee incentive stock options
- The experience of working in a cutting edge organization dedicated to achieving a better world
We’re an equal opportunities employer. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status, or any other trait protected under federal, state, or local laws.

postings.text:

postings.text:

At Orbital, we’re revolutionizing the development of advanced materials by replacing traditional trial-and-error methods with AI-driven rational design. Our technology accelerates innovation, helping bring cutting-edge materials from discovery to real-world applications faster than ever before.

postings.title: Full Stack Software  & AIEngineer
postings.text:
The Role
We are looking for a full-stack software engineer to build the next generation of scientist-centred AI tools for accelerating scientific discovery, our understanding of the universe, and solving climate change. This is a hybrid role with 2 to 3 days at our London office.
You’ll work closely with our computational and experimental groups to build agentic LLM tools which democratise the usage of Orbital Materials’ SOTA simulation models and work at the fore-front of AI-accelerated scientific research.
This role will be focused on delivering software which integrates frontier AI research into the workflow of scientists. This will involve designing and implementing front-end tools for novel interaction patterns with generative models, RAG, and scientific visualizations. This role will also design and build the back-end services which deliver agentic scientific workflows at scale, such as the orchestration of GPU-accelerated and traditional HPC workloads for atomistic simulation, and the processing of experimental data.
You will be working alongside the scientists who use these tools for every aspect of the materials discovery and technology development pipeline, and uniquely placed to guide the development of a new, AI-powered methodology for rapidly scaling crucial technologies for the energy transition.
Responsibilities:
- Design and implement full-stack web applications which expose cutting-edge scientific tooling to scientists
- Develop novel front-end interfaces which allow scientists to perform AI-accelerated research
- Develop back-end services which deliver AI-accelerated research, connecting diverse research tools, molecular simulations, physical lab equipment and LLMs
- Develop a suite of applications which provide utility to experimental chemists and integrate with central workflows
Skills & Experience:
- 3+ years of professional experience as a full-stack engineer
- A quantitative graduate degree
- Experience working with machine learning, LLMs, scientific tools/teams is a bonus
- Expert level experience with python and front-end javascript frameworks, react preferred.
What we offer
- Competitive base salary with AI sector
- Generous equity package
- Private Healthcare
- Pension
- Flexible and generous paid time off
- Regular team offsites and travel to US office
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information or any other category protected by law.

postings.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
postings.text:
Orbital Materials develops advanced materials and chemical processes by bridging the worlds of AI, Mechanical and Chemical engineering. We’re looking for ambitious thinkers and builders; those excited by the challenge of bridging AI and industry, chemistry and computation, discovery and deployment.
Our mission is to usher in an era where new advanced materials are no longer discovered, but are engineered with AI and we’ll use this to build technologies that solve major global technology challenges.
Joining Orbital Materials means working at the intersection of deep tech, applied science, and engineering innovation. We are a truly global organisation with teams in London (UK), San Francisco (CA) & Princeton (NJ), building teams in ML Research and Product Development to Mechanical and Chemical Engineering, offering opportunities for talented individuals who want to shape the future of materials and their applications in high-impact industries.
Role Overview
Orbital Materials is seeking a highly skilled and innovative Senior Mechanical Engineer to design and optimize advanced modular data centers, focusing on revolutionary two-phase direct-to-chip cooling applications leveraging Orbital's proprietary fluid discoveries, and developing dual-use chiller systems for simultaneous data center cooling and carbon capture.
This role involves hands-on participation in cutting-edge research, including design and layout of mechanical systems for data center equipment and actively participating in and conducting lab experiments to verify the validity and performance of our modular data centers, novel cooling solutions and integrated carbon capture systems.
Key Responsibilities
Mechanical Systems Design for Modular Data Centers and Cooling Solutions
- Selection of coils, heat exchangers, chillers, compressors,
- Working with key stakeholders to optimize designs for performance, manufacturability, and ease of deployment
Design and Thermodynamic Analysis for Cold Plate Cooling Systems
- Assist in setup, running and analysis of results for CFD
- Assist in setup, running and analysis of results for FEA
Design, Selection and Analysis of Refrigeration Systems
- Compare the impact on overall efficiency of the data center of different refrigerants for the ambient design condition
- Select compressors, expansion valves, and other supporting systems
Coordination, Review and Approval of Technical Reports and Documentation
- Review internal engineering work as well as external contractors such as CFD and FEA analysis
What We’re Looking For
- Professional engineering designation in Alberta, Canada or local regulatory body
- Experience in the design and equipment selection of mechanical systems used for data center cooling and/or HVAC systems
- Familiarity with various data center tiers and best practices for efficiency and reliability
- Continuous improvement mindset
- Experience in the design, selection, and optimization of chiller systems for large-scale cooling applications
- Proficiency in conducting thermodynamic analysis to optimize cooling system performance, energy efficiency, and heat transfer.
- Experience with relevant simulation software (e.g., CFD, FEA) for thermal and fluid dynamics an asset
- Practical experience in designing and executing lab experiments to validate the performance of mechanical systems, cooling solutions, and integrated systems.
- Ability to interpret experimental data and translate findings into design improvements.
- Experience in the selection and design of refrigeration systems and components
Why Join Orbital?
- Competitive salary commensurate with AI sector
- Flexible and generous paid time off
- 401K plan with a company match
- Excellent health, dental and vision insurance plans
- Equity package - the ability to own part of Orbital Materials as we grow
- Regular company offsites
- The experience of working in a cutting-edge organization dedicated to a better future
Orbital Materials is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

postings.text:

We’re looking for ambitious thinkers and builders; those excited by the challenge of bridging AI and industry, chemistry and computation, discovery and deployment.

Role Overview
In this role, you will be building your ideal team of professionals and establishing the quality department for a new suite of data center related products including a 2 Phase Direct to Chip cooling system utilizing a new novel coolant discovered by Orbitals AI technology, Coolant Distribution Units, Dual Use Chiller and Modular Data Centers.
Initially, this role will start with outsourcing production to contract manufacturing requiring the establishment of new processes and procedures for validating and onboarding suppliers.
In our 2nd phase, we will be establishing our in-house manufacturing capabilities requiring building of teams and processes from the ground up.
You will own product and process quality from concept through field life. Build a scalable QMS, prevent defects at the source, and ensure every unit (and module) ships safe, compliant, and reliable.
Key Responsibilities
Phase 1 — Contract Manufacturer Validation, Onboarding & Quality Management
- Source & qualify CMs and key suppliers: conduct technical/commercial audits (capacity, process capability, ISO 9001/14001, special processes related to quality, EHS)
- APQP at CMs: define CTQs/CTPs, control plans, PFMEA/DFMEA alignment, MSA, submission/approval of vendors; oversee FOK pilot builds.
- Quality agreements & documentation: establish supplier quality agreements, traceability schema (serial/lot genealogy), inspection/test instructions, packaging/labeling/handling standards.
- Performance management: implement supplier scorecards (OTD, PPM, responsiveness, audit scores); run QBRs; drive SCAR/CAPA with effectiveness verification and aging control.
- Field & commissioning interface for CM builds: define FAT/SAT witness criteria, release gates, and containment plans; triage escapes with 8D/A3 and feed lessons into CM control plans.
Phase 2 — Establish the In-House Quality Organization (New Manufacturing Plant)
- Build the QMS: implement ISO 9001 backbone (coordinate with 14001/45001 where relevant); write SOPs/WIs, MRB/CAPA governance, document control, and e-sign workflows.
- Factory quality architecture: stand up in-process, and final test (FAT) for CDUs and modular skids; define station-level CTQs, stop-the-line criteria, etc.
- People & org: hire, train, and coach inspectors, technicians, SQEs/CQEs; set tiered daily management (tier boards, paretos, andons) and a prevention-first culture (poka-yoke, error-proof fixtures).
- Systems integration: integrate Quality with PLM/ERP/MES for single source of truth; enable digital travelers, barcoding/RFID traceability, and automated data capture from test stands.
- Ramp & readiness: plan EVT/DVT/PVT at the plant; qualify production lines/process windows; lock control plans and release criteria before rate increase.
- Compliance & certifications: secure/maintain with the required multi-departmental team members UL/CSA/CE/UKCA, EMC/LVD, UL 508A for panels, pressure equipment (ASME/PED, CRN), refrigerant handling safety, RoHS/REACH documentation.
Ongoing, Cross-Phase Responsibilities
- Reliability & field quality: track MTBF/FFR, drive failure analysis (5-Whys, fishbone, FTA), manage warranty/RMA and design/process feedback loops.
- Continuous improvement & COPQ reduction: DOE, SPC, yield improvement, and cost-of-quality tracking; implement mistake-proofing and automation.
- Risk management: multi-tier mapping, single-point-of-failure mitigation, dual sourcing/tooling, business continuity playbooks.
- Data & reporting: dashboards for FPY, DPPM, escapes, NCR/CAPA aging, Cp/Cpk; automated alerts for trends and thresholds.
- Commissioning & site quality (modular DCs): align FAT/SAT with L1–L5 commissioning; define install standards (purge/evac/charge, wiring, firmware); train service partners.
What We’re Looking For
- Start-up Mindset: ability to work within the “gray” as a valuable team member to refine, clarify, and continuously improve and automate processes and designs.

postings.title: Electrical Engineer
postings.text:
Orbital’s hardware solutions solve the biggest challenges in data centers. Each of our products contains an advanced material discovered with our AI, giving it breakthrough real-world performance. We’re looking for ambitious thinkers and builders; those excited by the challenge of bridging AI and industry, chemistry and computation, discovery and deployment.
Our mission is to usher in an era where new, advanced materials are both discovered and engineered with AI and we’ll use this to build hardware that solve major global technology challenges.
Joining Orbital means working at the intersection of deep tech, applied science, and engineering innovation. We are a truly global organisation with sites in London (UK) San Francisco (CA), Princeton (NJ) & Calgary (Canada) building teams in ML Research and Product Development to Mechanical and Chemical Engineering, offering opportunities for talented individuals who want to shape the future of materials and their applications in high-impact industries.
Role Overview
The Electrical Engineer will play a critical leadership role in the design, development, and delivery of advanced electrical and controls systems for our engineered products and modular data centers. This position is responsible for owning the full electrical design lifecycle - from early-stage concept development to detailed construction-ready electrical installation drawing packages - using Autodesk Inventor, AutoCAD Electrical, and associated digital tools.
The successful candidate will lead electrical system architecture, coordinate with mechanical engineering, software teams, external stakeholders, future production personnel and ensure all electrical and controls designs meet safety, applicable codes, performance, regulatory and manufacturability requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Electrical Design and Engineering
- Develop complete electrical system architectures for industrial equipment, automation systems, and modular deployments including cable sizing and % fill calculations for tray and conduit.
- Produce detailed electrical installation drawings , wiring diagrams, schematics, harness/conduit routes, panel layouts, PLC I/O maps, and sensor/actuator integration.
- Model electrical components and cable paths within Autodesk Inventor assemblies, including point-to-point routing, conduit/cable tray design, and interference checks.
- Build and maintain electrical content libraries, templates, and standards to streamline repeatable design patterns.
Controls Engineering
- Define control strategies, functional specifications, and instrumentation selection for automated systems.
- Collaborate with client teams on PLC programming requirements, HMI architecture, and network/communication topology.
- Ensure controls logic, safety circuits, and emergency-stop logic comply with design standards (e.g., NFPA 79, IEC/UL, CSA).
Documentation & Deliverables
- Generate release-ready drawing packages including electrical installation drawings, panel fabrication drawings, BOMs, cable schedules, single-line diagrams, and load calculations.
- Lead internal design reviews and cross-disciplinary coordination to ensure seamless integration of electrical design with mechanical, thermal, and structural systems.
- Maintain engineering change documentation, revision control, and compliance with company quality procedures.
Technical Leadership
- Mentor current mechanical (and future electrical) engineers, designers, and drafters on best practices for electrical and controls installation to be able to assist in construction drawing creation.
- Champion design automation workflows with the AI team, including parameterized assemblies, iLogic, and Inventor-based electrical design acceleration.
- Engage in vendor coordination and review of supplier component specifications (switchgear, RPPs, PLCs, VFDs, sensors, etc.).
Compliance & Standards
- Ensure all designs meet relevant electrical codes and standards (NEC, CEC, UL/CSA, NFPA 70/79, IEC).
- Conduct arc-flash calculations, load studies, and grounding/bonding design where required.
- Support testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting during build or integration phases.
What We’re Looking For
- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent; P.Eng. or ability to obtain is required. You will be the first member of the electrical team.
- 5+ years of experience in electrical and controls design.
- Experience in 3D CAD software, Autodesk Inventor or equivalent.
- Strong experience producing electrical installation drawings, control panel layouts, and industrial wiring schematics.
- Deep understanding of PLC I/O interactions, instrumentation, VFDs, safety circuits, and industrial control systems.
- Working knowledge of relevant electrical standards and codes.
- Experience with AutoCAD Electrical, Inventor Cable & Harness, and 3D panel design workflows is an asset.
- Familiarity with modular equipment (data center specific equipment experience an asset), power distribution (480V/600V), and low-voltage controls integration.
- Proven experience in control system and electrical design for HVAC, industrial equipment, advanced manufacturing, or automation systems.
Why Join Orbital?
- Competitive salary and equity package - the ability to own part of Orbital as we grow
- Flexible and generous paid time off
- Excellent health, dental and vision insurance plan
- Regular company offsites
- The experience of working in a cutting-edge organisation dedicated to a better future
Orbital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

postings.title: Engineering Manager
postings.text:
Orbital is an AI-first industrial company building hardware from the atoms up. Our goal is to lead an industrial renaissance to advance critical technologies and secure our planet for generations to come.
We’re starting with critical hardware for AI data centers to make them more performant and sustainable. Every Orbital product is invented with our AI platform — uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance.
We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing.
Working at Orbital means working in tightly integrated vertically integrated teams. We’re looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn.
Role Overview
Orbital’s internal AI software platform is used by our materials scientists, hardware engineers and manufacturing engineers to design and build our products serving critical industries. Powering this software are our world leading AI models in advanced materials, hardware engineering and simulation.
As Engineering Manager at Orbital you will own the design and delivery of this software platform, called Curie. An example of a feature you may have to design and deliver is a single context graph across materials, engineering and manufacturing for our AI agents.
In this role you will also provide technical leadership and management - setting high engineering standards, driving projects from prototype to production deployment, and managing a software team.
First and foremost, we want to work with someone with a love of craftsmanship, continual learning and building systems that scale.
Key Responsibilities
Own engineering of the Curie platform
- Architecture: Define and evolve the technical blueprint for Curie, ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
- Quality: Establish and enforce rigorous standards for code quality, testing, monitoring, and overall system reliability.
- Delivery: Drive efficient and predictable delivery of high-quality software features in alignment with product goals and timelines.
Build and scale the team
- Hiring: Lead the recruitment process for new engineers, focusing on attracting top-tier talent that aligns with Orbital's technical and cultural requirements.
- Mentoring: Provide guidance, support, and professional development opportunities to the engineering team to foster continuous growth and skill enhancement.
- Establishing engineering culture as we grow internationally: Define, promote, and maintain a high-performance, collaborative, and inclusive engineering culture across all current and future global offices.
What We’re Looking For
- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a focus on backend engineering, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership or management role.
- Proven experience shipping and iterating on user-facing products, with a strong sense of what makes software useful, reliable and delightful
- The ability to move fluently between hands-on engineering and people management
- Strong product instincts and the ability to partner closely with product, design and stakeholders to shape roadmaps, make scope trade-offs and deliver meaningful outcomes
- Solid engineering fundamentals with the ability to set high standards for code quality, system architecture and engineering practices across a team
- Experience building and growing high-performing engineering teams — hiring, developing talent, giving clear feedback, and creating an environment where people do the best work of their careers
- Can balance technical depth with strategic thinking.
- A genuine interest in building software that enables breakthrough scientific and industrial applications, and the ability to translate that ambition into concrete plans a team can rally behind
- Bonus: Previous experience working in an AI/ML environment - you don't need to be an ML engineer, but familiarity with the workflows, tooling and pace of AI teams is a real advantage
Upon reading Hamming's You and Your Research , you resonate with quotes such as:
- "Yes, I would like to do first-class work"
- "You should do your job in such a fashion that others can build on top of it, so they will indeed say, 'Yes, I've stood on so and so's shoulders and I saw further.'"
- "Instead of attacking isolated problems, I made the resolution that I would never again solve an isolated problem except as characteristic of a class"
Why Join Orbital?
- Competitive salary and equity package - the ability to own part of Orbital as we grow
- Flexible and generous paid time off
- Excellent health, dental and vision insurance plan
- Regular company off-sites to the USA and beyond
- The experience of working in a cutting-edge organisation dedicated to a better future
